name: web-qa
description: AI-assisted web-application QA skill: enters a web app as a real user, drives a headless browser to simulate end-to-end journeys, captures evidence (DOM, console, network, screenshot), applies deterministic gates, and judges whether the user's goal was actually achieved — catching bugs that pass every objective check but are still wrong. Can also record a human-driven session (logging every interaction, screen and API call, with credentials redacted in-page) to map surfaces automated crawling cannot reach.
